Product Roadmap Review - 2026/04/14 10:02 CDT - Notes by Gemini

Invited dana.patel@ellavox.dev Dana Patel marcus.webb@ellavox.dev Marcus Webb priya.sharma@ellavox.dev Priya Sharma

Summary
The team reviewed Q3 roadmap candidates and agreed to prioritize the mobile offline mode ahead of the reporting revamp. Offline mode is scoped for a beta in six weeks. The reporting revamp moves to early Q4 pending the analytics vendor decision. Two action items were captured around the beta rollout plan and the vendor scorecard.

Details
Marcus raised that the current sync layer drops queued mutations when the app backgrounded on iOS. Dana will write the rollout plan for the beta including feature-flag gating and a rollback path. Priya presented the vendor scorecard for the analytics replacement; the team asked for a cost comparison at three usage tiers before the next review.
